turns.text: Hello, I just opened my delivery and the print has a deep crease along the corner.

I'm sorry your print arrived creased. To file a damage claim, I need your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with. Once I have them, I'll record the damage, and staff will ask you for a photo and decide on the next step.
Order SC-4090, email is emily.clark.v2@example.com. Please file a damage claim for a refund.

Thank you, Emily. Your order SC-4090 is verified, and I've filed a damage claim (R-1) for the crease on the Whispering Pines print, with a refund requested. The request is pending and staff must approve it. Staff will ask you for a photo of the crease and make the final decision. A colleague will contact you about the photo.

change.description: Print 'Whispering Pines' (40x50 cm) arrived with a deep crease along the corner.

turns.text: Actually, I really love the art itself. Could I please get a reprint instead of a refund?

Of course, Emily. I've updated your damage claim R-1 on order SC-4090 to request a reprint instead of a refund. It is still pending, and staff must approve it. Staff will ask you for a photo of the crease and make the final decision.
